title: Rating Leaderboard Cutoff
source: 215. Kth Largest Element in an Array
brief: Our game publishes a weekly leaderboard of rating changes, which can be negative after a bad week. Prizes go to the top k places, and the prize service needs the rating change that sits at place k.

Implement kthRankedScore(nums, k), where nums holds every player's rating change in no particular order and k is the place being asked about, counting from the top, and return the rating change at that place.
